paragraphes: Sign up for our newsletter and enjoy 10% off your first piece.
Step into the universe of Awrea Paris and receive our news and new pieces before anyone else.

fenetre.consentement: I agree to receive the Maison’s letter by email. I can unsubscribe at any time, in one click.
fenetre.conditions: 10% off a single piece, the most expensive one in your basket, all pieces included. Valid for 14 days after you confirm your sign-up, for a first order, once per email address, and not combinable with another code.

merci.texte: If this address is not signed up yet, an email from the Maison is on its way: click its link to confirm your sign-up and open your privilege, valid for 14 days on a first order.

erreurs.email: Enter a complete email address, for example name@example.com.
erreurs.consentement: Tick the box to receive the letter and your privilege.
erreurs.verification: The anti-robot check did not go through. Please try again.
erreurs.limite: Several attempts in a short time: please try again in a few minutes.
erreurs.generale: Your sign-up could not be saved. Please try again.

seo.title: Confirm your sign-up | Awrea Paris
seo.description: Confirmation of your sign-up to the Awrea Paris letter.

confirmation.avant: One click on the button confirms your sign-up to the Maison’s letter.
confirmation.attente: One moment, we are confirming your sign-up…
confirmation.texte: The Maison’s letter will reach you a few times a season: a collection in the making, a chosen lace, a glimpse of the atelier.
confirmation.privilege: Your welcome privilege awaits you until {date}: 10% off your first piece, taken off automatically when you pay with this email address, on this device or once signed in to your account.

invalide.titre: This link is no longer valid
invalide.texte: It has expired, or your sign-up has changed since. Sign up again at the bottom of any page: a new link will be sent to you.

appareil.avant: This link applies your welcome privilege to orders placed from this device.
appareil.titre: Your privilege is ready on this device
appareil.privilege: It awaits you until {date}: 10% off your first piece, taken off automatically when you pay with this email address.

invalide.titre: This link is no longer valid
invalide.texte: It has expired, or your privilege has already been used. You can ask for a new one from your order summary.

confirmation.erreur: The confirmation did not go through. Try again in a moment.
